build_dataset: build a dataset for CIFAR10, CIFAR100, ImageNet, or iNaturalist with configurable transforms and sampling
build_transform: build a training or evaluation image transform pipeline with auto augmentation and normalization
create_INatDataset: create an iNaturalist dataset from JSON annotations with configurable taxonomy category and year
create_ImageNetDataset: create a subsampled ImageNet dataset with configurable sampling ratio and number of classes
make_subsampled_dataset: make a subsampled list of image instances from a directory with class-to-index mapping
